name: Tomas Tobé - Après le § 32 - Am 17
title: REPORT on the findings and recommendations of the Special Committee on the European Democracy Shield
part_text: 32a. Highlights the importance of safeguarding anonymous public participation by fully and properly implementing the rights to privacy and to the protection of personal data that constitute an indispensable prerequisite for the exercise of other fundamental human rights; calls on the Member States to put in place appropriate and effective safeguards to protect the identity of anonymous public participants and confidential sources;
